notes.title: Update to version 1.3.3, new Ren'Py and 64-bit support
notes.content:
I've updated the game to the latest Ren'Py version with 64-bit support, as requested (especially for Macs). The game should run much faster now as side effect.
Let me know if you encounter any issues!

notes.title: The sequel "Never Forget Me" is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Never Forget Me sees Amy after she married one of the four love interests of the first game, Aaron, Eddy, Lawrence or Hugh.

The game can be played either in pure Visual Novel mode, or with an optional stat-raising gameplay with Normal or Hard difficulty level.

The game features five different endings (for each character) based on your choices, plus two optional stat-based epilogues.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/534980/

notes.title: Linux achievements and cloud save enabled
notes.content:
Hi,
I've added the new Ren'Py Steam API, so achievements should also work under Linux. In addition I've also enabled the cloud saves. They're cross-platform so you can save and load from / to any OS! :)

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Always Remember Me, 15% off!
notes.content:
Always Remember Me is Now Available on Steam and is 15% off!*

Amy is desperate! Her boyfriend Aaron doesn't remember her anymore after a car accident!

Will you be able to make him remember again? Or perhaps it's time to move on. Maybe Amy will fall in love with someone else?

It's up to you to decide. Play this life simulation game with dating sim elements and shape Amy's destiny.

*Offer ends April 25 at 10AM Pacific Time
